terms.title: Terms of Service | ForgeHelm
terms.description: ForgeHelm SaaS subscription terms for Core, Professional, and Enterprise plans.

sections.heading: 1. Service Description
paragraphs: {studioNameEn} ({studioName}) provides the ForgeHelm enterprise code governance and compliance platform, including the SaaS management platform, Analysis Agent software, and related modules (compliance reports, SBOM, dashboard, risk questionnaire, AI ChatBot, tech stack migration, data quality).

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Responsibilities
bullets: You must provide accurate and complete registration information
You are responsible for account security; accounts must not be shared
Abuse of the service (attacks, spam, excessive automated requests) is prohibited
You are fully responsible for data you upload or submit

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions, Billing, and Refunds
bullets: ForgeHelm uses per-seat annual subscriptions (Core, Professional, Enterprise): annual fee = seat monthly rate × seats × 12 + platform annual fee (Professional / Enterprise)
Online payment is completed via Stripe Checkout on the ForgeHelm SaaS platform; enterprise procurement may use contracts, POs, or wire transfer
Trial Experience fees paid within 30 days before upgrading to Core or Professional annual subscription are fully credited toward the first annual fee
Seats may be adjusted during the contract term (proration); monthly billing, if offered, is typically ~20% higher than annual
Taiwan customers may receive tax invoices (Tax ID: {taxId})
Annual subscriptions are generally non-refundable once activated unless required by law or written agreement; service remains available through the subscription term

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
bullets: Compliance reports, SBOM, and dashboard data produced from your repositories belong to you for business use
ForgeHelm platform software, UI, and analysis algorithms are owned by {studioNameEn}
You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the service without authorization

sections.heading: 5. Changes and Termination
bullets: We may modify, suspend, or terminate the service
Material changes will be notified by email at least 30 days in advance
If we discontinue the service, we will provide notice and assist with data export

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
bullets: The service is provided "as is" without guarantee of error-free or uninterrupted operation
Reports are for reference only; decisions remain your responsibility
We are not liable for losses arising from use or inability to use the service
If liability applies, damages are capped at fees you paid for the service

sections.heading: 7. Governing Law
bullets: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
Disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Taipei District Court as the court of first instance

sections.heading: 8. Contact
bullets: Email: {email}
Tax ID: {taxId}
